Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the second essay! Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana are the openers. Ashleigh Gardner has the new ball in hand. Here we go...
... RUN CHASE ...

India looked helpless in the final stages but could have been the happier side to walk out however due to poor fielding and sloppy bowling in the death, they have an uphill task in front of them. The pitch is two-paced, the spinners controlled most of the time. Slower balls were key for India.  We know Australia have more pacers. Can they defend this total or India will cruise through? We will find out soon.

A superb score for Australia. They will take it with both hands. It was a watchful start from them. Australian batters got lifelines and they made most of it. Beth Mooney went onto score a fifty. Meg Lanning too made the most of it and gave the finish Australia wanted. Ashleigh Gardner too played a solid cameo to get the boost in the middle phase Australia were looking for.

Harmanpreet Kaur said at the toss they have to field well but it was the department they were mostly sloppy. Meg Lanning was dropped when she was new to the crease and she is the one who has given a grand stand finish.
SIX! A SUPERB FINISH! 18 runs off the over! A full toss on middle, Lanning tonks it over square leg for a six. AUSTRALIA FINISH WITH 172.
On middle, eased to long on for a single. Lanning to face the final ball.
Leg bye! A yorker, just around off. Lanning steps across to sweep but misses. It rolls off the pads to short fine leg for a leg bye.
A slower ball, full and on leg. Lanning makes room to heave but misses.

FOUR! It does not matter how it comes unless it comes for Australia. A slower ball, down the leg side. Lanning looks to sweep but gets a bottom edge, it rolls through her legs and to fine leg for four.
SIX! BANG! Perfect start! A full toss on middle. Lanning pulls and hits it behind square leg for a biggie. Pressure on Renuka.
On off, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single. 12 runs off it. Can Australia Women get near 165?
FOUR! 150 up! An off-cutter but Lanning reads and cuts it past point for four.
On the pads, nudged to deep mid-wicket for a single.
OUT! TIMBER! Harris goes! Pandey gets her second! An off-cutter, around off and on the fuller side. Harris is through her shot as she swings but misses and the ball shatters the stumps.
Fuller and outside off, driven through covers for a brace.
FOUR! Intent! A half-volley on middle. Harris whips it to deep square leg and beats the dive of Jemimah Rodrigues to find the fence.
Fuller and on middle, nudged to mid-wicket for a single.

OUT! BOWLED! A timely wicket for India! Deepti Sharma goes very full and around off. Gardner tries to jam t out through covers but misses and the ball hits the stumps. Cleverly bowled. India needed that. Ashleigh Gardner goes after a quick cameo.
Full and on off, tucked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, outside off, slower one. Lanning shuffles way across to paddle but misses and gets hit on the body.
Length ball on middle. Meg flicks it past square leg for a couple.
On the middle, Gardner plays it to long on for one.
A single as this full ball is flicked to mid-wicket.
Wrong end from the fielder! On middle, clipped to mid-wicket for a single. Jemimah Rodrigues fumbles and Gardner looks for one more but the throw comes at the bowler's end instead at the keeper.
Fuller and outside off, driven to cover.
A single as this is hit to long on.
FOUR! That has to be the shot of the day so far! Just superb! This is full and outside off, Gardner shuffles across and drives it firmly past cover, beats the fielder in the deep for a boundary.
FOUR! not a good start by Singh! On the pads, clipped past square leg for four.
Loopy ball on middle. Gardner looks to sweep but gets a top edge and it goes behind the keeper and falls safely for one.
FOUR! Two in two for Gardner! Too full and outside off. Gardner dances down the track and powers it to the left of long off for four.
FOUR! Gardner is getting a move on now! Tossed up on middle. Gardner moves across and slog-sweeps it in the gap to square leg for four more.
Flat and outside off, Lanning slaps it to covers for one more.
Too full, outside off, lofted to long off for a single.
Slower one on middle. Gardner flicks it to square leg where another fumble helps them get two.
FOUR! What an over for the batters! 14 off the over. Nicely threaded through, outside off, this is cut past point for four.
This one spins back in on off, punched to the left of the bowler for a single.
FOUR! Well played! This is slightly angled on the pads. Gardner uses the pace and helps it to fine leg for four.
Tososed up, outside off, Gardner punches it to cover.
On middle, worked to long on for a single.
FOUR! 100 up! Too full and on leg, Lanning sweeps it hard past square leg for a boundary.
Tad short and outside off, Meg pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one more. No pace at all, Australia Women have to generate power to go big here. Smart from India.
Around off, pushed to cover.
Short and outside off, slower. Lanning slaps it to deep cover for two. A fumble but just two.
On middle, Gardner pulls it to deep mid-wicket where the fielder makes a good stop. One.
Outside off, Lanning stays back and cuts it past cover for one.
Lanning comes down the track but this is very slow and wide of off. Lanning goes back and cuts it to cover. Good bowling.
Tossed up on off, Lanning steps down and pushes it to Rana who fumbles and it rolls to mid-wicket. A single is taken. India have been very poor on the field.
Outside off, kept out.
Wide! Down the lelg side, Lanning misses her pull shot.

Chance! Flighted, outside off. Lanning skips down to drive but misses. Richa Ghosh does not collect it properly and that gives a chance for Lanning to come back. If she had taken it cleanly, Lanning was long way out.
Short and outside off. Lanning cuts aerially and past point for a couple.
On a length and on middle, drilled to long on for a single.
Fuller and outside off, driven to cover.
Full and on middle, bunted to mid-wicket for a single.

OUT! TAKEN! Shafali Verma this time takes the catch! Dropped a few minutes ago but not this time. Flat and outside off. Mooney rocks back and cuts hard but uppishly and straight in the hands of point. India needed this one.
Commentary.Howout: c Shafali Verma b Shikha Pandey

Commentary.Commentary: Good fielding! A full toss, outside off, Mooney pulls it to deep square leg where Renuka Singh saves a couple as she dives to her left.
Flat and outside off, slapped to cover.
FOUR! Fifty for Mooney! Run machine! Quality striking from Mooney! Fuller and outside off. Mooney gets innovative as she laps it over third man for four.
FOUR! Very full and outside off, Mooney threads it past backward point and the ball wins the race. Four more.
9 runs off the over! Australia will be happy! Around off, dropped to point for a single.
Around the off pole, Lanning mistimes her pull to long on for a single.
On middle, turned to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Top shot! That is what Mooney can do, find the gaps! Tossed up, outside off. Mooney goes inside-out over covers and right between in the deep for four.
Too full and outside off, driven to cover-point for a run.
Tossed up on off, Mooney taps it to point for a single.

Drinks! Both the batters out there had a lifeline already. Australia Women are lucky. India Women though need to do better, both were easy ones but still they have done well to keep the run rate in check. However, the Aussies need one over to get the train back on track. They need to go big now to get a score above 150.
On middle, eased to long on for a single.
Outside off, cut to cover.

FOUR! DROPPED! Two catches dropped now! Shafali Verma took it a bit lightly. Flat and around off. Mooney tries to power over long on but hits it straight to long on. It was an easy catch but Shafali Verma drops it. It rolls behind for four.
Goes quick now on middle. Kept out.
FOUR! Finds the fence! A low full toss, angling across the batter. Mooney skips down and drags. The fielder at mid-wicket leaps but it goes over and to the fence.
Flat and outside off, slower. Lanning hits it past cover for a single.
Despite a no ball, just five off it. On middle. Mooney gets down the track to block.
Outside off, cut straight to point.
A single as Lanning plays it through mid-wicket.
The catch is taken but it was a free hit! Tossed up, outside off. Lanning steps across to slog-sweep but mistimes straight in the hands of mid-wicket.
On middle. Lanning sweeps it past square leg for a couple. A NO BALL as Rana has overstepped. Free-hit next.

Put down by the keeper! Ohh, what a chance! Flat and outside off, skids on. Lanning goes back to punch but gets an outside edge. The deflection was seen but the keeper fails to hold on. Will this haunt India?
On off, worked through covers for a single.
On the pads, tucked to square leg for one.
Lanning is off the mark! Tossed up on off, played to covers for a quick single.
Full and outside off, pushed to cover.

OUT! STUMPED! Healy goes! Yadav serves a full ball, outside off at 69 clicks. Yes, it was that slow. Healy skips down to go downtown but swings in the air and Richa Ghosh at the back removes the bails easily. Fifty stand and then first wicket.
Commentary.Howout: st Richa Ghosh b Radha Yadav

Commentary.Commentary: Full and on leg, Mooney chips it wide of long on for a single.
FOUR! 50 up! Yadav sees Mooney come down the track and serves it slow but Mooney does well  to time it through covers in the gap for a boundary.
Length ball, outside off, worked through covers for one.
A length ball on middle. Healy comes down the track but mistimes her hit to long on for one.
This is full and on middle. Healy blocks it out.
TAP AND RUN! On off, dropped to covers for a single.
Outside off, punched to covers.
A length ball, outside off. Healy guides it to backward point for a single.
Misfield! Outside off, cut to point where the fielder lets it through for two runs.
SIX! The first of the game! Floated, outside off. Mooney stays back and powers it over long off for a six. Welcome boundary.
Slower ball, outside off, Mooney keeps it out.
One run saved! Fuller and outside off, driven through cover-point. Two Indian players chase and does well to save one.

Deepti Sharma flights this full and on middle. Healy steps across, gets on her knee but misses and might have got hit on the pads. India put on the appeal but nothing doing. Kaur walks across and has a chat to Sharma as she eventually takes this upstairs. Ultra Edge shows the ball hits the gloves. Not out it is!
Flatter ball, outside off. Mooney plays it past covers for a single.
Two good overs by India! Outside off, dabbed straight to backward point.
Slower, full and outside off. Healy makes room to drive but misses.
Length and on off, knocked to covers for one.
Superb in the deep! On the pads, clipped to deep mid-wicket. Jemimah Rodrigues runs to her right, dives and this time does well to keep the ball away.
Wide! Angles it across the batter, outside off. Mooney slashes and misses.
This is full and around off, Mooney drives but finds mid off.
On off, worked to covers for a single.
Good comeback from Sharma after going for a four! Flat and outside off, slapped to point.
On middle, worked to long on for a single.
Tossed up, around off, Healy looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Slow in the air, outside off. Healy tries to reverse hit but misses.
Too short again, outside off, cut to point.
FOUR! Deepti Sharma tries to do something different, this is short and well wide. Healy skips down and slaps it past mid off for a boundary. Australia Women with a good start here.
This one stays low off the pitch, outside off, Healy drags it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On the pads this time, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Tight bowling from Singh! This is full and around off. Mooney defends.
Full and on middle, eased to long on for one.
Angles a length ball on middle. Defended out.
FOUR! That is some shot! Length and on off. Healy gets inside the line of the ball and goes over mid on for another boundary.
FOUR! So the boundary ruins a good over! 8 runs off it. Short and wide again, Mooney cuts it late past backward point for four.
Outside off again, cut through covers for a single.
Shorter and outside off, Mooney goes back and strokes it past point for one.
Too wide, outside off. Healy cuts it to deep cover for one.
Mooney is underway! Short and outside off, it is punched to deep cover for one.
Floated on middle, pushed to mid off.
Deepti Sharma to bowl from the other side.
101 clicks! On middle, Healy blocks to cover.
Goes a bit wide and angles it on middle. Healy drives it to the right of mid on where Shafali Verma half-stops and the batters take two runs.
Targets the off stump. Healy drops it to point. Three dots now.
A length ball on middle. Healy punches it straight to mid on.
On a length and on middle, swings in. Blocked out.

FOUR! Australia are off the mark in style! A half-volley to start with, outside off. Healy leans and drives it to deep point. Jemimah Rodrigues dives to her left and gets a hand but fails to keep it away.

The Indian players are out in the middle. They need a good start to keep Australia quiet from the start but it will be hard as the Aussies have a very long tail. Renuka Singh to bowl first. Alyssa Healy and Beth Mooney to open for Australia. Let's play....

The stage is set. It cannot get better than this. Two top teams going against each other to fight for the place at the podium. Both teams are out there for the national anthems. It will be India first followed by Australia.

PITCH REPORT - Ian Bishop says it is a fresh pitch and one of the square boundaries is long. Anjum Chopra joins and says there are some green patches and it is on the middle line. The seamers will love to bowl on it.

India Women (PLAYING XI) - Shafali Verma, Smriti Mandhana, Jemimah Rodrigues, Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Richa Ghosh (WK), Deepti Sharma, Yastika Bhatia, Sneh Rana, Shikha Pandey, Radha Yadav, Renuka Singh.

Australia Women (PLAYING XI) - Alyssa Healy (WK), Beth Mooney, Meg Lanning (C), Ashleigh Gardner, Ellyse Perry, Tahlia McGrath, Grace Harris, Jess Jonassen, Georgia Wareham, Megan Schutt, Darcie Brown.

Harmanpreet Kaur informs Pooja Vastrakar is out of this game and Sneh Rana replaces her. Radha Yadav and Yastika Bhatia also come in for Rajeshwari Gayakwad and Devika Vaidya. Tells they have to bat well in this game. Reckons they have to be on top of their game today.

Meg Lanning says they will bat first, good wicket and they will love to put runs on board. Informs Jess Jonassen and Alyssa Healy come in for Alana King and Annabel Sutherland. Reckons they have to go out there and adjusts according to the conditions.
TOSS - Australia Women have won the toss and will BAT first!
